decision: Publish every cluster feature declared by the pinned original Ephys Atlas project repository.
display_policy: Raw values, statistics, regional summaries, and underlying-value downloads remain unchanged. Automatic robust bounds replace the legacy fixed XLIMS. Exact linear and logarithmic histogram binnings are both emitted for audited strictly-positive heavy-tailed quantities, with Log preferred; other features remain linear-only.

features.label: Maximum spike amplitude
features.description: Maximum spike amplitude for each cluster, summarized regionally over all finite clusters.

features.label: Minimum spike amplitude
features.description: Minimum spike amplitude for each cluster, summarized regionally over all finite clusters.

features.label: Median spike amplitude
features.description: Geometric median spike amplitude for each cluster, summarized regionally over all finite clusters.

features.label: Spike amplitude variability
features.description: Standard deviation of log-scaled spike amplitudes for each cluster, summarized regionally over all finite clusters.

features.label: Contamination estimate
features.description: Refractory-period contamination estimate for each cluster; this source metric is not constrained to the interval zero to one.

features.label: Alternative contamination estimate
features.description: Alternative refractory-period contamination estimate for each cluster, summarized regionally over all finite clusters.

features.label: Depth drift rate
features.description: Accumulated absolute spike-depth change per recording hour for each cluster, summarized regionally over all finite clusters.

features.label: Estimated missed spikes
features.description: Estimated fraction of missed spikes from the amplitude distribution, capped by the source algorithm at 0.5.

features.label: Noise cutoff score
features.description: Signed standardized amplitude-histogram cutoff score for each cluster, summarized regionally over all finite clusters.

features.label: Presence ratio
features.description: Fraction of recording time bins containing at least one spike for each cluster, summarized regionally over all finite clusters.

features.label: Spike-count variability
features.description: Standard deviation of raw spike counts across presence-ratio time bins for each cluster; despite the source name, it is not the standard deviation of a bounded ratio.

features.label: Sliding refractory-period pass fraction
features.description: Regional fraction of source clusters whose binary legacy sliding refractory-period metric equals one (pass).

features.label: Spike count
features.description: Number of spikes assigned to each cluster, summarized regionally over all finite clusters.

features.label: Firing rate
features.description: Spike count divided by recording duration for each cluster, summarized regionally over all finite clusters.
